items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: You mentioned something about you worked with Buddy Petit... Yeah, first band I played in the cabaret... Joe was watching them.

ctx.x: A wonderful ear of some of those people.
Now Buddy Petit, well, he's time that, had about five. Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly, Rene, Sam Morgan. Yeah, they had the town.
You mentioned something about you worked with Buddy Petit, that's when you gave up your other job.
